programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026: Opening Ceremony
programme.desc: Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the first of three opening ceremonies, which comes from Mexico City Stadium ahead of the first game of the tournament, and includes performances by Colombian reggaeton star J Balvin and South African singer-songwriter Tyla. As befits a tournament in which many aspects will feel different, three host nations mean three opening ceremonies, with ones to follow in Toronto and Los Angeles tomorrow. There's also a look ahead to the competition, as well a focus on the match between Mexico and South Africa, which will be the first of 104 in a marathon event. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 26 Live
programme.desc: Mexico v South Africa (Kick-off 8.00pm). Joanne Cantwell presents coverage of the Group A match at Mexico City Stadium, which serves as the opening game of the tournament. This is the fifth overall meeting between these nations, with the most recent also being the opening contest of the 2010 World Cup in South Africa, which ended in a 1-1 draw. That was the last time Bafana Bafana competed in a World Cup and, as with their two other tournament appearances in 1998 and 2002, they failed to progress beyond the group stage, whereas El Tricolor finished second in the group to progress to the last-16, where they were beaten 3-1 by Argentina. Last time out in Qatar they failed to progress from a group that also included Argentina, Poland and Saudi Arabia, and their best-ever performances in the 17 previous appearances saw them reach the quarter-final stage as sole hosts in both 1970 and 1986

programme.title: FIFA WC2026: S. Korea v Czech Rep
programme.desc: South Korea v Czechia (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group A match at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. The Koreans are appearing at their 11th tournament in succession, and a 12th overall, and qualified after going unbeaten in 16 total matches across two rounds of qualifying in the Asian Confederation. Their best-ever performance at a World Cup saw them finish fourth in 2002 when they served as co-hosts alongside Japan, but since then they have failed to progress beyond the last-16, which was as far as they went four years ago in Qatar after suffering a 4-1 loss to Brazil in Doha. For Czechia, this is their first appearance at a World Cup since 2006 in Germany, and they were made to work hard for their place as they finished second in their qualifying group behind Croatia, which led to a place in the play-offs where they triumphed twice in penalty shootouts against Republic of Ireland and Denmark after both games ended in 2-2 draws. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Qatar v Switzerland (Kick-off 8.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group B match at San Francisco Bay Area Stadium in Santa Clara, USA. Qatar have earned outright qualification for a World Cup for the first time in their history, having made their only previous appearance at the tournament when they served as hosts four years ago. They'll hope to improve on that showing, when they lost all three of their group games against Netherlands, Senegal and Ecuador, scoring just one goal against the Senegalese in the process. The Swiss reached their sixth consecutive finals and 13th overall by topping a qualification group that contained Kosovo, Slovenia and Sweden, winning four and drawing two of their matches, while scoring 14 goals and conceding just two. There has only ever been one previous meeting between these nations, and Qatar will hope to replicate the outcome of that friendly in 2018, in which they claimed a 1-0 victory. With analysis from Gary Neville, Ian Wright and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: Before they leave the Blue Mountains, Barney has an extreme challenge planned for his dad as they must traverse a ravine on a rope. Later, the road trip takes them to a tiny town where they join the local community who have organised a challenge that involves pulling a gigantic truck

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Australia v Türkiye (Kick-off 5.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The Socceroos are appearing at their sixth consecutive finals, and a seventh overall, and will hope to build on their experience in Qatar four years ago when they progressed to the knockout stage for just the second time. They faced European opposition twice in the group stage on that occasion and had mixed fortunes, beginning their campaign with a 4-1 loss to eventual runners-up France, before beating Denmark 1-0 in their final group match, which helped them to move on to a meeting with eventual winners Argentina. In contrast, Türkiye have only appeared in World Cup finals on two previous occasions, most recently in 2002 when the competition had co-hosts for the first time in Japan and South Korea, and they will hope to perform just as admirably as they did on that occasion when they reached the semi-finals and were beaten 1-0 by eventual champions Brazil. With analysis from Ange Postecoglou and Juan Mata, and commentary by Joe Speight and Lucy Ward

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: The chef visits the Languedoc region, famous for its wine and the hearty, meaty dish cassoulet, and stops at a roadside fruit stall owned by a couple of British expats, before creating an unusual dish using melon and onion rings. He meets a modest chef who prepares a mouth-watering cassoulet, before staying at an 18th-century coach house and visiting a museum dedicated to Citroen 2CVs

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: The chef travels through Charente in south-west France, visiting a distillery in the Cognac region, meeting a miller who still uses traditional methods to make award-winning brioche loaves, and following in the Queen Mother's footsteps with a visit to Chateau de Venteuil, home of the De La Rochefoucauld family. Along the way he makes classic French onion soup and a salad incorporating some of the region's best produce, and pays homage to the patron saint of pastry chefs with a stunning dessert

programme.desc: Germany v Curaçao (Kick-off 6.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group E match at Houston Stadium in the USA. The Caribbean outfit face one of football's most decorated nations in their first-ever World Cup finals match as they go up against the four-time champions, who have also reached the final on four other occasions. Since their most recent World Cup victory at the 2014 tournament in Brazil, Die Mannschaft have failed to progress from the group stage and have only won two matches at the last two tournaments combined. Julian Nagelsmann's men came through qualifying with a record of five wins and one loss so will be confident of performing better this time around, but will be wary of an opponent they know little about having never faced them before, but who went undefeated in two stages of qualifying in the CONCACAF region. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Netherlands v Japan (Kick-off 9.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group F match at Dallas Stadium in the USA. There have been three previous meetings between these nations, including a group-stage match at the 2010 World Cup in South Africa when a second-half goal from Wesley Sneijder was enough to give the Dutch a 1-0 victory. Both teams went on to progress to the knockout stage, and while the Japanese would bow out in the last-16, Oranje made it all the way to the final but fell short of victory in a 1-0 loss to Spain. Both teams were present at the previous World Cup in Qatar, and both topped their respective groups, with the Dutch leading Group A ahead of Senegal, Ecuador, and the host nation, while Samurai Blue bested Spain, Germany and Costa Rica. The most recent clash between tonight's opponents was a friendly match in 2013 that took place in Belgium, which saw Japan salvage a 2-2 draw after being 2-0 down. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ange Postecoglu, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist

Spain won this tournament in 2010 and are among the favourites to do so once again, having won Euro 2024 and qualified from a group containing Türkiye, Georgia and Bulgaria with five wins, a draw and no defeats. They were also runners-up to Portugal in last year's UEFA Nations League, and their squad boasts the talents of the likes of Barcelona stars Pedri and Lamine Yamal, who is an injury doubt for the group stage, and Manchester City's 2024 Ballon d'or winner Rodri. Cape Verde are one of the tournament outsiders and it would be a major upset should they manage to get a result this evening, but they impressed in qualifying, topping a group that contained the likes of Cameroon, Libya and Angola. They have few players among their ranks who would be widely considered as household names, but are likely to look to captain and all-time leading goalscorer Ryan Mendes for inspiration. programme.desc: Argentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: England v Croatia (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Dallas Stadium in the USA, as Thomas Tuchel's side get their campaign under way. These two teams last met at the European Championships held in 2021, with England winning a group stage encounter 1-0 at Wembley Stadium thanks to a second-half finish from Raheem Sterling. They also met in the semi-finals of the 2018 World Cup in Russia, when Croatia came from behind to win 2-1 in extra-time and reach their first major final. Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ian Wright, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon

This is their fifth appearance at the World Cup finals and their second successive tournament after taking part four years ago in Qatar. Their opponents tonight also finished top of their qualifying group in the CONCACAF region, boasting an unbeaten record in Group A with three wins and three draws from their six fixtures, as The Canal Men reached their second World Cup after also making it to the 2018 tournament in Russia. programme.desc: Netherlands v Japan (Kick-off 9.00pm). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group F match at Dallas Stadium in the USA. There have been three previous meetings between these nations, including a group-stage match at the 2010 World Cup in South Africa when a second-half goal from Wesley Sneijder was enough to give the Dutch a 1-0 victory. Both teams went on to progress to the knockout stage, and while the Japanese would bow out in the last-16, Oranje made it all the way to the final but fell short of victory in a 1-0 loss to Spain. Both teams were present at the previous World Cup in Qatar, and both topped their respective groups, with the Dutch leading Group A ahead of Senegal, Ecuador, and the host nation, while Samurai Blue bested Spain, Germany and Costa Rica. The most recent clash between tonight's opponents was a friendly match in 2013 that took place in Belgium, which saw Japan salvage a 2-2 draw after being 2-0 down. programme.desc: England v Croatia (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Dallas Stadium in the USA, as Thomas Tuchel's side get their campaign under way. programme.desc: Mexico v South Africa (Kick-off 8.00pm). Joanne Cantwell presents coverage of the Group A match at Mexico City Stadium, which serves as the opening game of the tournament. This is the fifth overall meeting between these nations, with the most recent also being the opening contest of the 2010 World Cup in South Africa, which ended in a 1-1 draw. There have been three previous meetings between these nations, including a group-stage match at the 2010 World Cup in South Africa when a second-half goal from Wesley Sneijder was enough to give the Dutch a 1-0 victory. Both teams went on to progress to the knockout stage, and while the Japanese would bow out in the last-16, Oranje made it all the way to the final but fell short of victory in a 1-0 loss to Spain. Both teams were present at the previous World Cup in Qatar, and both topped their respective groups, with the Dutch leading Group A ahead of Senegal, Ecuador, and the host nation, while Samurai Blue bested Spain, Germany and Costa Rica. Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Argentina v Algeria (Kick-off 2.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as the reigning champions play their first game in defence of their title. The South Americans beat France on penalties in the 2022 final after the game had ended 3-3 after extra-time in one of the most thrilling finals of all time, with France's Kylian Mbappe scoring only the second ever hat-trick in a World Cup final. That was Argentina's third success at this tournament after victories in 1978 and 1986. They will be looking to become just the third country to retain the trophy and the first to do it since Brazil won back-to-back titles in 1958 and 1962. Their opponents today are playing in their first World Cup since 2014, when they made it through to the last 16 before losing to eventual winners Germany 2-1 after extra-time. That was the African country's best performance at this tournament after failing to make it out of the group stage in their other two appearances at the finals. With analysis from Patrick Vieira, Karen Carney and Duncan Ferguson, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: England v Croatia (Kick-off 9.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Dallas Stadium in the USA, as Thomas Tuchel's side get their campaign under way. These two teams last met at the European Championships held in 2021, with England winning a group stage encounter 1-0 at Wembley Stadium thanks to a second-half finish from Raheem Sterling. They also met in the semi-finals of the 2018 World Cup in Russia, when Croatia came from behind to win 2-1 in extra-time and reach their first major final. Kieran Trippier scored a fifth-minute free-kick in that meeting to give England the lead but The Checkered Ones replied in the 68th minute thanks to Ivan Perisic's goal to take it to another 30 minutes. Mario Mandzukic then scored with 11 minutes of extra time to play, ending the Three Lions' quest to reach their first World Cup final since 1966. With analysis from Roy Keane, Gary Neville and Ian Wright, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Ghana v Panama (Kick-off 12.00am). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the Group L match at Toronto Stadium in Canada, as these two sides get their tournaments under way in their first-ever meeting. Ghana made it through to the finals after finishing top of CAF qualifying Group I, above the likes of Madagascar, Mali and Comoros after winning eight of their 10 matches. This is their fifth appearance at the World Cup finals and their second successive tournament after taking part four years ago in Qatar. Their opponents tonight also finished top of their qualifying group in the CONCACAF region, boasting an unbeaten record in Group A with three wins and three draws from their six fixtures, as The Canal Men reached their second World Cup after also making it to the 2018 tournament in Russia. With analysis from by Emma Hayes and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Jon Champion and Ally McCoist

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Master
programme.desc: ... Blackmailer. 1992. Director: Peter Hammond. Stars Jeremy Brett, Edward Hardwicke & Robert Hardy. Holmes and Watson attempt to break the grip of a ruthless blackmailer of their clients.

programme.title: La Fin du Jour
programme.desc: 1939. Drama. Director: Julien Duvivier. Stars Louis Jouvet, Michel Simon & Victor Francen. A few actors live together in a retirement home. One day an old friend arrives, reigniting old feelings.

programme.title: You'll Never Get Rich
programme.desc: 1941. Comedy. Directed by Sidney Lanfield. Stars Fred Astaire, Rita Hayworth & Robert Benchley. A womanising theatre producer's efforts to cover up an affair leads to romance for a dance duo.

programme.title: A Lifetime Ago with The Baim Collection
programme.desc: Between Those Four Walls. A nostalgic reminder of 1962 interior home decoration overloaded with facts and figures, with an insight into paper, manufacture and wallpaper design.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: By the Deep Six. Western with Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray, who run a stagecoach line in the Old West where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: Bad Company. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Judy Geeson & Kenneth Farrington. A new commanding officer's method of discipline border on psychotic, the men consider mutiny.

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. The Apprentice. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: Life In Emergency Ward 10
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Based on the smash hit TV series about the daily life and the ups and downs of a hospital. Stars Michael Craig, Wilfred Hyde-White and Joan Sims.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout June.

programme.title: The Durant Affair
programme.desc: 1962. Drama. Directed by Godfrey Grayson. Stars Jane Griffiths, Conrad Phillips. When a wealthy society hostess dies, the search begins for the rightful heir, unveiling an unexpected heiress.

programme.title: Paul Temple's Triumph
programme.desc: 1950. Nettlefold Films production directed by Maclean Rogers and starring John Bentley & Dinah Sheridan. Paul Temple is on the hunt for a kidnapped scientist who's invented a secret formula.

programme.title: Laurel and Hardy - The Magicians
programme.desc: 1929. rare short piece of the duo performing as magicians, with hilarious results.

programme.title: Star Performance: To Kill a Man
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by James Neilson. Stars Alexis Smith, Scott Forbes, Dan Barton & Ross Elliott. A dinner party is unexpectedly interrupted by an intruder.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Monks Hood Murder. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Charles Morgan. Mrs. Vincent makes a complaint that Dr. Sneddon murdered her husband, he said he died of consumption.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: The Black Castle. 1956. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. Torwald holds Lord Trebizond to ransom in the Black Castle. Lorraine, rides to Camelot to seek help.

programme.title: Seance On A Wet Afternoon
programme.desc: 1964. Thriller. Director: Bryan Forbes. Stars Richard Attenborough, Nanette Newman & Kim Stanley. A medium stages a kidnapping which she will then 'solve' by pretending to be psychic.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Betty Curtis unlocks the vault to bring you a fabulous performance of Soldi Soldi Soldi.

programme.title: Blackout
programme.desc: 1950. Crime Noir. Director: Robert S Baker. Written by John Gilling. Stars Maxwell Reed & Dinah Sheridan. An ambulance drops a blind patient to the wrong address, where he stumbles over a body.

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: The Newcastle Train Murder. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Judith Rowbotham & Alan Moss. The murder of John Innes Nisbet in 1910 resulted in his killer becoming the last man hanged by Newcastle jail.

programme.title: Strange But True?
programme.desc: UFOs - Pilots/Kaikoura Lights. 1995. Michael Aspel introduces pilots who speak for the first time about UFOs they have seen and UFO sightings on one night in the Kaikoura Peninsula in New Zealand.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: The Hammond Account. 1974. Stars Robin Chadwick, Derek Benfield & Jennifer Wilson. Hammond Transport is once again in the position for expansion. Barbara returns from abroad with some news.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Field Goal. 1958. Stars Donald Gray, Gordon Tanner & Colin Tapley. Mark Saber and Larry Nelson are investigating the murder of Mrs Radford's husband.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 2. 1974. Performances from some of the best known singers of the time. Featuring, the Three Degrees, Ronnie Hilton and Bill Haley and the Comets perform their famous hits.

programme.title: Adventures of a Private Eye
programme.desc: 1977. Comedy. Director: Stanley Long. Stars Chris Neil, Suzy Kendall, Harry H. Corbett. While his boss is away, Bob helps a model being blackmailed, finds a dead body & ends up in a cabaret club.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: 1989. Drama. Director: Michael Caton-Jones. Stars John Hurt, Joanne Whalley & Bridget Fonda. An affair between an exotic dancer and the Minister of War shakes up the British government.

programme.title: Doomwatch
programme.desc: Flight into Yesterday. 1971. Stars John Paul & Desmond Llewelyn. After a long-haul flight Dr Quist's reputation is put in doubt when he arrives drunk to a meeting with the Prime Minister.

programme.title: The Blue Parrot
programme.desc: 1954. Crime Drama starring Dermot Walsh, Jacqueline Hill, Ferdy Mayne and John Le Mesurier. A Soho nightclub is the focus for an undercover investigation after the murder of a small time crook.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Settle in for a wonderful performance of Baby Madison by The Milords.

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: 1964. Who Killed Andy Zygmunt? Directed by Don Taylor. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. Pop artist Andy Zygmunt is fatally impaled on the spikes of one of his creations.

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: Seventeen Seconds to Glory. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Judy Geeson & Nick Tate. Ash learns how to dispose the new German land mines, thanks to the help of naval experts.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout June.

programme.title: Stranger In Town
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Directed George Pollock. Starring Alex Nicol, Anne Paige & Mary Laura Wood. In a sleepy village, a composer is shot dead and a woman is found gassed. Who killed them and why?

programme.title: Suddenly
programme.desc: 1954. Drama. Director: Lewis Allen. Stars Frank Sinatra, Sterling Hayden & James Gleason. Three gangsters trap a family in their own house, with the intention of killing the president of the USA.

programme.title: Look At Life Our for a Catch
programme.desc: 1964. A look into the fascinating aspects of angling, some of which are tragic. For example, the miles of inland waterway so polluted that no fish can live in them.

programme.title: No Trace
programme.desc: 1950. Drama. Directed by John Gilling. Writer Robert Southley finds his lifestyle threatened by blackmail from a former US criminal associate. Stars Hugh Sinclair, Dinah Sheridan & John Laurie.

programme.title: The Lucy Show
programme.desc: Lucy and George Burns. 1966. Stars Lucille Ball & Gale Gordon. When visiting the bank, George Burns finds out that Lucy is naturally funny and asks her to become a part of his show.

programme.title: Star Performance
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by Reginald Le Borg. Stars Dan O'Herlihy, Phyllis Coates & Mary Scott. A British army captain has a chance meeting with the army nurse he romanced a decade earlier.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Penny Plains. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Charles Morgan. An attempt is made on a wealthy woman's life. Marriott is put on the case but finds himself falling for her.

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: Return To Sender. 1963. Directed by Gordon Hales. Stars Nigel Davenport, Yvonne Romain, Geoffrey Keen & William Russel. Dino Steffano is arrested as he is about the leave the country.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Betrothal. 1955. Betrothal. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Rufus Cruickshank. Once again Sir Richard of the Lea has financial troubles due to his heavy gambling.

programme.title: Dancing With Crime
programme.desc: 1947. Crime Drama. Directed by John Paddy Carstairs. Stars Richard Attenborough, Barry K. Barnes, Sheila Sim & Garry Marsh. A Cab driver gets mistaken with a gang. He sets out to expose the group.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: In this wonderful music video from the 60s, Italian singer and actress Mina performs Pesci Rossi.

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: Washday S.O.S. 1962. Stars John Ireland, Peter Illing & Gerard Heinz. Hunter goes undercover behind the Iron Curtain when the widow of a world-renowned doctor believes her husband is still alive.

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: The Breach In The Dyke. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas & Shelagh Fraser. Out in France John gets separated from the division. Meanwhile, Margaret returns home.

programme.title: Hannay
programme.desc: The Hazard of the Die. 1988. Stars Robert Powell, Christopher Scoular & Gavin Richards. Hannay saves the life of a desperate woman, not knowing this act of bravery will bring him to his enemy.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Happy Go Lucky. 1964. Stars Kate Allitt, John Barrard & Michael Barrington. Nick Parks cannot stop stealing. Barlow gets a tip about an associate that may lead to the clearing of Nick's crimes.

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1971. Detective & Mystery Drama. Come Into The Garden, Rose. Stars Alfred Burke, Margaret Anderson & Graham Armitage. Marker encounters some strong and powerful women.

programme.title: Play for Today: Abigail's Party
programme.desc: Abigail's Party. 1978. Stars Alison Steadman, Tim Stern & Janine Duvitski. Middle-class suburbia gets to reveal its darker side over the course of an increasingly uncomfortable drinks party.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Opening the Cellar Club tonight is Caroline Munro, here to introduce the next episode of The Omega Factor!

programme.title: The Omega Factor
programme.desc: Out of Body, Out of Mind. 1979. Stars James Hazeldine, Louise Jameson & John Carlisle. Michael has a newly discovered ability to dream of incidents which occur at places he has never been to.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Next up, Caroline Munro introduces the 1940s film Case of the Frightened Lady, staring Marius Goring, Penelope Dudley-Ward, Helen Haye & Ronald Shiner!

programme.title: The Case of the Frightened Lady
programme.desc: 1940. Stars Marius Goring, Penelope Dudley-Ward & Helen Haye. Mark's Priory is the family seat of the Lebanons. Lady Lebanon is desperate to have an heir to carry on the family name.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Caroline Munro closes the show but not before exploring what is coming next week at the Cellar Club!

programme.title: Operation Bottleneck
programme.desc: 1961. Drama. Director: Edward L. Cahn. Stars Ron Foster, Miiko Taka & Norman Alden. Six paratroopers undertake an extremely dangerous mission against the Japanese.

programme.title: A Lifetime Ago with The Baim Collection
programme.desc: A Printer's Tale. 1960. A 'fact full' film showing the work at Leeds printer John Waddington, featuring pictures printed for jigsaws, boxes for toothpaste and enormous posters.

programme.title: Lord Tramp
programme.desc: 1977. Comedy. Southern TV Series. A tramp inherits a title, country house and fortune. But how will it affect him? Starring Hugh Lloyd, Joan Sims, George Moon and Alfie Bass (S1, E06)

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Dr. Damon's Experiment. 1954. Stars Sandra Dorne & Laurence Naismith. An eminent psychiatrist returns home early from a conference to find his wife with another man, leading him to seek revenge.

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: Butterfly Winter. 1979. Stars Anthony Andrews, Kenneth Cranham & Geraldine Gardner. Ash and the men of 347 Section tackle Hitler's latest deadly invention, the butterfly bomb.

programme.title: The Hi-jackers
programme.desc: 1963. Drama. Director: Jim O'Connolly. Stars Anthony Booth & Jacqueline Ellis. A lorry driver meets Shirley at a cafe and offers her a lift. His truck carrying valuable whiskey is later hijacked.
